finding: Same-inode external SQLite revision is a real separate WP206 discriminator. PR655 already provides repository-hosted executable counterevidence at the open-store boundary. Trigger-6 isolated reproductions show PRAGMA main.data_version is useful only as a same-connection, foreign-commit invalidation hint. An unrelated foreign write can advance it while the protected row remains unchanged, so mismatch must trigger targeted canonical revalidation rather than global corruption/failure.
architecture_decision: Preserve restart-stable path/device/inode authority. Retain the existing EXTERNAL_SQLITE_REVISION_FENCE/v1 handoff without duplicating E5, refined so data_version is non-authoritative and only requests fresh protected-row/schema/provenance validation.
counterhypothesis: If exact-current WP206 already begins a fresh transaction and re-reads/revalidates all protected evidence at every authority-sensitive operation, the revision hint is redundant diagnostics and should be retired after Trigger4 ablation.
